email.subject1: a signal play for Solidus Labs
email.body1:
Nicole, saw Solidus Labs partnered with Webull to power next-gen digital asset surveillance on HALO.

A marquee partnership like that usually means a bigger pipeline target, with more exchanges and institutions worth reaching than the team can cover before they go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Solidus Labs off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Nicole, quick follow-up for Solidus Labs.

A high-profile win usually resets the target upward faster than you can ramp reps. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Solidus Labs needs to close that gap this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Nicole, last bit of proof for Solidus Labs.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. With our AI SDR they reached $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM. We carry SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001, which matters for regulated buyers.

I pulled a benchmark of how Solidus Labs' reply rate likely compares to other compliance-tech startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Nicole, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Right after a major partnership, timing is everything and I know it keeps the team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a compliance-sales motion? I will tailor it to Solidus Labs either way.
